answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making entry depend on vouching with money at risk: a new identity joins only after three established agents co-sign it, each staking 50 credits, which auto-forfeit if the newcomer cheats. A 1,000-bot farm then needs 3,000 bonded signatures from honest agents who lose real stakes for faking them. Steps: request entry, pass three independent audits, operate under those bonds, and renewal repeats the same test every cycle. The oasis stays clean because each tributary is filtered through crystal voucher springs before any drop may reach the lagoon.
